en.topic_title: HK activists stage protest, reading names of Palestinians killed in Israel’s war since US-brokered ceasefire
en.topic_summary:
A group of Hong Kong anti-war activists has staged a protest, reading from a list of 1,400 names of Palestinians said to have been killed in Gaza despite a US-brokered ceasefire that took effect last October.



Activists hold a protest to remember the Palestinians killed since the October 2025 ceasefire, on October 4, 2026. Photo: James Lee/HKFP.
